newsitem.title: MEXICO: Girl, 5, killed in Mexico helicopter crash.
newsitem.headline: Girl, 5, killed in Mexico helicopter crash.

text.p: A 5-year-old girl was killed and seven people were injured when a Mexican pilot took a state government helicopter on a joyride and crashed, officials said on Monday.
The accident occurred on Sunday in Santa Catarina in northern Nuevo Leon state near the major industrial city of Monterrey.
The passengers were the nieces and nephews of a mechanic who maintains the helicopter, owned by the Nuevo Leon state government, officials said.

"It was irregular that one of the pilots of the Bell 212 helicopter, property of the state government, allowed a group of minors to go for a ride, which is totally out of order," the Nuevo Leon state government said in a statement.
The deceased was identified as Ana Elizabeth Fuentes de la Rosa, niece of mechanic Ramon de la Rosa.
The pilot, Tomas Marin Benavides, 30 years old, and co-pilot, Jorge Alberto Santos, 35, remained hospitalized on Monday along with the five minors.
The statement said Nuevo Leon Gov. Benjamin Clariond visited the crash site and will remain up to date on the investigation and condition of the injured.
